title: Centralized control over the user experience not only leads to enshittification, but to "despotification"; decentralized protocols bring back democratic ideals (Mike Masnick/Liberalism.org)
summary: Mike Masnick / Liberalism.org: Centralized control over the user experience not only leads to enshittification, but to “despotification”; decentralized protocols bring back democratic ideals — In January 2011, somewhere in the crush of bodies in Cairo's Tahrir Square, a man held up a handwritten sign.
